name: Tool Belt
description: A collection of tools covering common Drupal core actions (built on the Tool module).
project_description:
Tool Belt provides a collection of tools for common Drupal core actions. Built on top of the Tool API , it offers a suite of submodules that streamline content management, entity manipulation, user administration, development tasks and system operations. Think of it as a starter set of tools to use across AI, ECA and so on.

 We will continue to add more tools for more complete Drupal core coverage.

 Submodules 
 Tool Belt - Content 
 Tools for creating, editing and deleting content entities and field data.

 Tools provided: Delete entity, Get field value definitions,

Get field values, List entities, Load entity by ID, Load entity by property,

Add new entity revision, Save entity, Create unsaved entity, Set field value.

 For more details see the README file .

 Tool Belt - Entity 
 Tools for creating, modifying and describing content entity and field

definitions.

 Tools provided: Add bundle, Get bundle definition, Delete bundle,

Get field configuration definitions, List entity bundles, Update bundle,

List entity types, Add field to bundle, Delete field from bundle,

Add field storage, Delete field from entity type, Update field storage,

Get field type definitions, Update field on bundle.

 For more details see the README file .

 Tool Belt - System 
 Miscellaneous system tools.

 Tools provided: Display message, Log message, Send email,

Get system status.

 For more details see the README file .

 Tool Belt - User 
 Tools provided: Add role to user, Block user, Remove role from user, Unblock user.

 For more details see the README file .

 Tool Belt - Content Translation 
 Content translation tools.

 Tools provided: Get an entity translation.

 For more details see the README file .

 Tool Belt - Workspace 
 Workspace management tools that integrate the Tool module with Drupal's

Workspaces module.

 Tools provided: Check workspace exists, Get active workspace,

Create workspace, Switch workspace, Create and switch to workspace,

Get workspace tracked content, Publish workspace, Revert workspace,

Generate workspace preview link, Delete workspace.

 For more details see the README file .

tool_plugins.label: Create entity
tool_plugins.description: Create and save an entity in one call, with base field and configurable field values.

tool_plugins.label: Delete entity
tool_plugins.description: Delete an entity by type and ID.

tool_plugins.label: Get field value definitions
tool_plugins.description: Get base field and configurable field value schema for an entity type and bundle.

tool_plugins.label: Get field values
tool_plugins.description: Get field values from an entity with optional field filtering. Each field is returned as a list of item objects holding the properties the value input of field_set_value takes.

tool_plugins.label: List entities
tool_plugins.description: List content entities with filtering, sorting, and field selection.

tool_plugins.label: Load entity by ID
tool_plugins.description: Load a content entity by its type and ID.

tool_plugins.label: Load entity by property
tool_plugins.description: Load entities by matching a property/field value.

tool_plugins.label: Get entity metadata
tool_plugins.description: Get metadata for a content entity. Accepts either a loaded entity or an entity type ID and entity ID combination.

tool_plugins.label: Add new entity revision
tool_plugins.description: Adds a new unsaved revision of an existing entity.  This should always be used when editing existing content entities prior to saving.

tool_plugins.label: Save entity
tool_plugins.description: Save an entity.

tool_plugins.label: Create unsaved entity
tool_plugins.description: Create a new unsaved entity with properties.  Best when used with additional tools to modify the entity and save it.

tool_plugins.label: Update entity
tool_plugins.description: Update and save an entity in one call. Works like a patch: only the fields passed are changed, everything else is left alone.

tool_plugins.label: Set field value
tool_plugins.description: Set a field value on an entity.

tool_plugins.label: Explain text formats
tool_plugins.description: Describe the text formats available to the current user: their enabled filters, allowed HTML tags and authoring guidance. Use before writing formatted text fields.

tool_plugins.label: Preview formatted text
tool_plugins.description: Run text through a text format and return the HTML that survives its filters. Use to verify markup before saving formatted text fields.

tool_plugins.label: List content by moderation state
tool_plugins.description: List content whose latest revision's default translation is in a given moderation state. Results are filtered by the current user's view access.

tool_plugins.label: Get moderation state
tool_plugins.description: Get the moderation state of an entity and the transitions available to the current user from that state. Use before setting a moderation state.

tool_plugins.label: Set moderation state
tool_plugins.description: Move an entity to a new moderation state, creating a new revision. The transition is validated against the workflow and the current user's transition permissions, exactly as the entity form validates it.

tool_plugins.label: List workflows
tool_plugins.description: List content moderation workflows with their states, transitions and whether the current user may use each transition.

tool_plugins.label: Get an entity translation
tool_plugins.description: Load a translation of an entity, adding it in memory when missing. Persist an added translation with the entity save tool.

tool_plugins.label: Add bundle
tool_plugins.description: Adds a new bundle for a given entity type.

tool_plugins.label: Get bundle definition
tool_plugins.description: Returns the bundle definition and properties schema for a given entity type.

tool_plugins.label: Delete bundle
tool_plugins.description: Delete the entity bundle by entity type ID and bundle machine name.

tool_plugins.label: Get field configuration definitions
tool_plugins.description: Get detailed field and storage configuration, and settings schemas for an entity type and bundle.

tool_plugins.label: List entity bundles
tool_plugins.description: Returns a list of bundles and their settings for a given entity type.

tool_plugins.label: Update bundle
tool_plugins.description: Updates an existing bundle for a given entity type.

tool_plugins.label: List entity types
tool_plugins.description: Get a list of all content entity types with their bundles

tool_plugins.label: Add field to bundle
tool_plugins.description: Adds a field instance to a bundle using an existing field storage.

tool_plugins.label: Delete field from bundle
tool_plugins.description: Deletes a field instance from a specific bundle. The field storage will remain unless no other bundles use it.

tool_plugins.label: Add field storage
tool_plugins.description: Creates a new field storage configuration for an entity type.

tool_plugins.label: Delete field from entity type
tool_plugins.description: Deletes an existing field storage configuration(and all instances) from an entity type.

tool_plugins.label: Update field storage
tool_plugins.description: Updates an existing field storage configuration.

tool_plugins.label: Get field type definitions
tool_plugins.description: Get definitions of all available field types on the site with their settings schemas

tool_plugins.label: Update field on bundle
tool_plugins.description: Updates a field instance on a bundle.

tool_plugins.label: Add image effect
tool_plugins.description: Append an effect to an image style. Use the list image effect plugins tool to discover effect IDs and their settings.

tool_plugins.label: List image effect plugins
tool_plugins.description: List the available image effect plugins with their default settings. Use before adding effects to an image style.

tool_plugins.label: Remove image effect
tool_plugins.description: Remove an effect from an image style by its UUID. Use the list image styles tool to find effect UUIDs.

tool_plugins.label: Add image style
tool_plugins.description: Create a new, empty image style. Add effects with the add image effect tool.

tool_plugins.label: Delete image style
tool_plugins.description: Delete an image style. Generated derivative images are removed; displays that used the style are left without a working style.

tool_plugins.label: List image styles
tool_plugins.description: List image styles with their effects and settings.

tool_plugins.label: Display message
tool_plugins.description: Display a message to the user via Drupal's messenger system.

tool_plugins.label: Log message
tool_plugins.description: Log a message to the Drupal logging system.

tool_plugins.label: Send email
tool_plugins.description: Send an email with specified recipient, subject and body.

tool_plugins.label: Get system status
tool_plugins.description: Get the Drupal system status information including warnings and errors.

tool_plugins.label: Add role to user
tool_plugins.description: Add a role to a user account.

tool_plugins.label: Block user
tool_plugins.description: Block a user account.

tool_plugins.label: Remove role from user
tool_plugins.description: Remove a role from a user account.

tool_plugins.label: Unblock user
tool_plugins.description: Unblock a user account.

tool_plugins.label: Create workspace
tool_plugins.description: Creates a new workspace without switching to it.

tool_plugins.label: Create and switch to workspace
tool_plugins.description: Creates a new workspace and immediately switches to it. If switching fails, the workspace creation is rolled back.

tool_plugins.label: Delete workspace
tool_plugins.description: Deletes a workspace and all its tracked content associations. The active workspace cannot be deleted.

tool_plugins.label: Check workspace exists
tool_plugins.description: Verifies if a workspace with the given ID or label exists.

tool_plugins.label: Get active workspace
tool_plugins.description: Returns information about the currently active workspace, or indicates if viewing the Live site.

tool_plugins.label: Generate workspace preview link
tool_plugins.description: Generates a shareable preview link for a workspace. Requires the Workspace Preview module.

tool_plugins.label: Publish workspace
tool_plugins.description: Publishes all tracked content in a workspace to Live. Only top-level workspaces can be published.

tool_plugins.label: Revert workspace
tool_plugins.description: Reverts a published (closed) workspace, undoing its changes from Live and reopening it. Requires the WSE module.

tool_plugins.label: Switch workspace
tool_plugins.description: Switches the current session to an existing workspace.

tool_plugins.label: Get workspace tracked content
tool_plugins.description: Returns tracked content in a workspace with summary counts and optional detailed listing.
